entries.german: Stephan und Johannes Herzoge in Bayern verheissen Arnolden von Rosenberg an der über 800 fl. sich belaufenden und ihm auf dem Umgelt in Bayern angewiesenen Schuld auf Michaelis 200 fl. zu gewähren, bis zur völligen Bezahlung. G. Ingolstadt, Montag vor Laurenti. (Arrod. III. 641.)
entries.english: Stephan and Hans, Herzoge in Bayern, promise Arnold von Rosenberg to pay 200 florins at Michaelmas on the debt, amounting to over 800 florins and assigned to him on the Umgeld in Bavaria, until full payment. Given at Ingolstadt, on the Monday before St. Lawrence. (Arrod. III. 641.)

facts.content: was promised payments at Michaelmas by Stephan and Hans, Herzoge in Bayern, until a debt assigned to him on the Umgelt in Bavaria was paid in full.
